== Update - September 1, 2026 ==

=== Skill updates ===

* {{skill icon|Mirage Cloak}}: Adjust additional block chance to 4..10 (so that Earth investment is required) and fixed a bug where damage from enchantment removal was getting improperly multiplied.
* {{skill icon|Focused Shot}}: Removed errant cast time.
* {{skill icon|Soul Twisting (PvP)}}: Fix typos in in-game description.
* {{skill icon|Animate Flesh Golem}}: Pull the (somehow) living Vabbian peasant from the corpse pool.
* {{skill icon|Symbols of Inspiration}}: Reduce recharge from 15 to 10 and increase duration from 1..31 to 6..40. (This change was in the original update notes, but the game data wasn't properly updated.)
* {{skill icon|Mistrust}}: Fix bug where original target was being treated as an AoE target.
* {{skill icon|Overload}}: Fix bug where original target was being treated as an AoE target.

=== Guild Wars Wiki notes ===
* Build: 38,888
